checks.name: Python 3.12
checks.hint: Instalar Python 3.12 e adicionar ao PATH.

test.name: Instalar dependencias de teste
test.command: & '%PYTHON%' -m pip install --upgrade pip; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; & '%PYTHON%' -m pip install -r requirements-dev.txt

build.name: Instalar dependencias de build
build.command: & '%PYTHON%' -m pip install --upgrade pip; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; & '%PYTHON%' -m pip install -r requirements-dev.txt

build.name: Verificar LAS_CAFIISICA.exe
build.command: $exe=Join-Path $env:LOCALAPPDATA 'LBM\LASCAFIISICA\dist\LAS_CAFIISICA\LAS_CAFIISICA.exe'; if (!(Test-Path $exe)) { throw ('LAS_CAFIISICA.exe nao foi gerado: ' + $exe) }; Get-Item $exe | Select-Object FullName,Length,LastWriteTime

build.name: Self-test do executavel
build.command: $dist=Join-Path $env:LOCALAPPDATA 'LBM\LASCAFIISICA\dist\LAS_CAFIISICA'; Push-Location $dist; try { Remove-Item LAS_CAFIISICA_SELF_TEST.txt -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; & ./LAS_CAFIISICA.exe --self-test; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; if (!(Test-Path './LAS_CAFIISICA_SELF_TEST.txt')) { throw 'Self-test nao criou relatorio' }; Get-Content ./LAS_CAFIISICA_SELF_TEST.txt } finally { Pop-Location }

build.name: Preparar pacote portatil
build.command: $root=Join-Path $env:LOCALAPPDATA 'LBM\LASCAFIISICA'; $pkg=Join-Path $root 'package'; $dist=Join-Path $root 'dist\LAS_CAFIISICA'; if (Test-Path $pkg) { Remove-Item $pkg -Recurse -Force }; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $pkg, '%LATEST%', '%ARCHIVE%' | Out-Null; Copy-Item -Recurse $dist (Join-Path $pkg 'LAS_CAFIISICA'); Copy-Item -Force 'packaging/START_LAS_CAFIISICA.bat' $pkg; Copy-Item -Force 'packaging/LEIA_ME.txt' $pkg; Copy-Item -Force 'README.md' $pkg
